name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act - Personal Data Security Safeguards
what_it_decides: Mandates reasonable security safeguards to prevent personal data breach and requires redacting unconsented personal identifiable information (PII) before model processing.

name: Processing of Personal Data of Children and Behavioral Tracking Prohibition
what_it_decides: Prohibits tracking, behavioral monitoring, or targeted advertising directed at children through AI models without verifiable parental consent.

name: Mandatory Cyber Security Incident and Access Log Retention
standard: CERT-In Directions under Section 70B of IT Act 2000
what_it_decides: Mandates maintaining secure, tamper-evident logs of all ICT systems and model access records for a rolling period of 180 days within Indian jurisdiction.

name: Automated Financial Decision Governance and Model Explainability
standard: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) IT Governance and Model Risk Guidelines
what_it_decides: Requires explainability audit trails, model risk governance, and explicit human accountability verification for autonomous credit, underwriting, or financial decisioning pipelines.
